## DonutChart

Generic SVG donut chart with animated entry, an empty-total state, and a configurable center label/value. Extracted from the mortgage calculator's monthly-breakdown donut and generalized: the center caption and total formatting are caller-supplied.

### Import

```ts
import { DonutChart, type DonutSlice } from '../charts/donut-chart';
```

### Usage

```gts
<DonutChart @data={{this.slices}} @size={{200}} @centerLabel='TOTAL' />
```

- `@data` — `DonutSlice[]`: `{ label, value, color, class? }`.
- `@size` — pixel size (default 220).
- `@centerLabel` — small caption above the center value; omitted entirely when not passed.
- `@centerValue` / `@formatTotal` — override the center text, or format the computed total (default compact number).
- A zero/empty total renders a neutral full circle instead of slices.
- The chart draws slices only; render your own legend from the same data (see the Metrics Report POC card).
